theorems.name: Submission.br_weightedTangent_congr
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (M M' : Set (Eucl P)) (θ θ' : Eucl P → ℝ) (x : Eucl P) (V : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen V → x ∈ V → (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) (symmDiff M M' ∩ V) = 0 → (∀ᵐ y ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M ∩ V)), θ y = θ' y) → θ x = θ' x → ∀ L : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M θ x L → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M' θ' x L
